title: Combining Molecular Dynamics and Machine Learning to Predict Drug Resistance Causing Variants of BRAF in Colorectal Cancer.
summary: REST2 molecular-dynamics trajectories and a random-forest classifier relate BRAF variant conformational features to predicted dabrafenib/vemurafenib resistance in colorectal-cancer models; this is a computational variant hypothesis without direct drug-response experiments in this study.
